work_unit.title: 为 Verrail 浏览器验收分配独占动态端口
work_unit.goal: 让验收 runner 在未显式指定端口时分配可用 loopback 端口，并把同一端口传给 Playwright 配置与被测服务器。

reason: The release browser gate timed out before running tests because port 3203 belonged to a long-lived Domain API; the CLI moved the test server to 3211 while Playwright continued polling 3203.

rules: Honor an explicitly supplied VERRAIL_ACCEPTANCE_PORT without rewriting it.
When no override exists, allocate an available IPv4 loopback port and propagate it to the Playwright child.
Do not terminate or reuse unrelated services already bound to a port.
Keep the isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME cleanup contract intact.
